value.name: Asha guides Lucia to sign
value.description: Asha positions the pen in Lucia's hand and nudges it into place so Lucia can sign the document.
evidence: with her other hand she nudged the pen the last inch until it touched the side of Lucia's thumb
Before Asha could answer, Rosa reached forward between the seats and pressed Lucia's fist closed more firmly around the barrel of the pen

value.name: Lucia hesitates before taking the pen
value.description: Lucia pauses without moving, then takes the pen and grips it tightly, showing reluctance and resolve.
evidence: Lucia did not move for a long moment; then she drew her hand out from under Asha's and closed her fingers around the pen, gripping it harder than the act required

value.name: Lucia asks about legal binding
value.description: Lucia asks whether signing will legally bind her letter to the rest of the pages in court.
evidence: "If I sign this," she said, looking at neither of them, "does it bind what I wrote in the letter to the rest of these pages, in front of a court."

value.name: Rosa steadies Lucia's hand
value.description: Rosa intervenes physically, holding Lucia's fist closed around the pen as if helping a child write.
evidence: Rosa reached forward between the seats and pressed Lucia's fist closed more firmly around the barrel of the pen, the way she might have steadied a child's hand at a stove, and held it there

value.name: Asha confirms the signature's legal effect
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that signing will bind the letter to the rest of the pages.
evidence: "Yes," Asha said, holding Lucia's gaze across the dim cabin. "It binds them."

value.name: Asha guides pen to signature line
value.description: Asha moves Lucia's hand down the page and positions the pen above the first signature line.
evidence: She moved her hand back to Lucia's and guided the gripped pen down the page until the nib hovered above the first signature line

value.name: Rosa urges Lucia to sign
value.description: Rosa leans in close and insists that the signature will bind everything, prompting Lucia to proceed.
evidence: Rosa did not let go of Lucia's fist; she leaned forward until her shoulder pressed against the back of Lucia's seat and said, almost into her ear, "It binds everything," and tipped her chin once toward the line

value.name: Lucia signs the document
value.description: Lucia takes a breath, commits to the act, and writes her name in a heavy, uneven hand.
evidence: Lucia drew a breath that caught at the top of her chest, then bore down, and the pen scratched out her name in a heavy, uneven hand

value.name: Lucia's hidden pocket remains empty
value.description: As Lucia signs, the empty cardigan pocket and the pale embossed seal emphasize the document's prior handling and the significance of the act.
evidence: the cardigan pocket gaping empty at her hip and the embossed seal showing pale through the page where Rosa had pressed it earlier
